  • Constructor Details

    • OtherActivity

      public OtherActivity(String title, Time start, Time end, String comment, String location)
      Creates an other activity, throws an argument exception if any value is invalid
      Parameters:
      title - the title, cannot be empty
      start - the starting time
      end - the ending time, must be after the start
      comment - an optional comment, null is treated as empty
      location - where the activity happens, cannot be empty
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the title, times or location are invalid
